senses.gloss: f. (preced.; cmp. חֲזָזִית) a rough, scabby surface, scar.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 75a:12">Keth. 75ᵃ</cite> if a dog bit her, <he>ונעשה מקומו צ׳</he> and the spot of the bite became scarred.

<cite ref="Niddah 55a:13">Nidd. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>בשר … צ׳</he> if a piece of flesh is cut out, the spot becomes scarred. Sifra Thazr. Par. 3, ch. VI; Par. 4, ch. VII; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:2:3">Y. Pes. VII, 34ᵃ</cite> bot. (synonymous with <cite ref="R00734"><he>צָרֶבֶת</he></cite>). V. <cite ref="R00195"><he>צוּלְקָא</he></cite>.
